articles.title: The agentic CFO in your pocket
articles.snippet: Chalom explains that retail investors have never had the opportunity to access and manage their own digital treasury desk. Until now.

articles.title: StablR Euro and USD stablecoins depeg amid ongoing $2.8M exploit
articles.snippet: Blockaid said the suspected cause is a private key compromise of one owner in the minting multisig account.

articles.title: DeFi hacks shake institutional confidence as risks outpace yields
articles.snippet: Repeated bridge exploits and shrinking yields are making institutions question whether DeFi’s risks still justify the returns, says Symbiotic’s Putiatin.

articles.title: THORChain exploit tied to malicious node and GG20 flaw
articles.snippet: The $10.7 million THORChain exploit was caused by a GG20 vulnerability, which allowed a malicious node to reconstruct a full private key to one of its vaults.

articles.title: Polymarket Hit By ‘Internal Top-Up’ Wallet Exploit, $700K Drained
articles.snippet: User funds remain safe after the incident, the prediction market platform said, with contracts and core infrastructure unaffected.
